About/ 01

Who I Am &
What I Build

I'm Veda Shivayogi Ramagondanahalli — an AI engineer and M.Tech student at REVA University, Bangalore, specializing in Artificial Intelligence.

My work lives at the intersection of computer vision, intelligent web systems, and data science. I build things that range from YOLOv5-powered face recognition to full-stack voice AI systems and interactive Power BI dashboards.

I believe in learning by building — 24 projects, 31 certifications, and counting. Every project is a chance to push into new territory and create something that genuinely works.

"Combining AI + web + animation to create smart, interactive, and beautiful software."
